claims.statement: Referee George Siler said Mike McCoole beat Tom Allen for the championship of the world in 1870.
claims.excerpt: who beat Tom Allen for the championship of the worid in 1870

claims.statement: Referee George Siler said Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole badly, at a time not given.
claims.excerpt: who was itn turn beaten badly by Allen

claims.statement: Mike McCoole died a pauper in New Orleans and was rescued from a pauper's grave by Tom Allen.
claims.excerpt: was rescued from a pauper’s grave by is old foeman, Allen.

fights.excerpt: who beat Tom Allen for the championship of the worid in 1870
fights.notes: Siler's recollection, 1897. Conflicts with the other records: Allen's 1870 fight was with Jem Mace, and his later bouts with McCoole were won by Allen.

fights.excerpt: who was itn turn beaten badly by Allen
fights.notes: Siler gives no date or details. It may be one of the 1869 or 1873 bouts.

notes: Siler's account is a recollection of events 20 to 30 years earlier. The 1870 result conflicts with the other records, so confidence is medium. McCoole's name is printed 'MeCoole' in the text and read as McCoole.
